title: Short Stack Count
description: mod that shortens big numbers by adding suffixes, e.g. 1,234 → 1.2K
body:
# short stack count
this is a mod that shortens numbers above 1,000 to their suffixed counterparts in any GUI that calls `GuiGraphics.drawString`, for example, 1,234 → 1.2K, 1,234,567,890 → 1.2B, etc. up to 10¹⁸ (quintillion / Qn)

## config
the mod has multiple configuration options (`shortstackcount.toml`):
- `enabled` - controls whether the number formatting is enabled
- `convertMbToLiters` - toggles optional fluid support which converts buckets into metric liters
- `precision` - the number of decimal places in formatted numbers

## preview
the functionality is best seen in something like [EMI](https://modrinth.com/mod/emi)'s recipe tree:
![a screenshot of an EMI recipe tree with big numbers that are formatted by the mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/acdc4366cb4fe5961457e0b1e96b878c9bb11de8.png)
